revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 5.6% and FY2024 5.1%; fade toward long-run defense budget growth of ~3% as the backlog normalizes.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: held at FY2025 actual 10.3% (7731/75048); FY2024 9.9%, FY2023 12.6%; no recovery assumed given program charges.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2025 effective rate of about 15% (pretax 5922 vs net income 5017) plus a modest step up toward the 21% statutory rate. Damodaran's industry effective rate is 11.6%.

wacc.source: CAPM. Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06). ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16). Unlevered beta 0.869 (Damodaran Aerospace/Defense, cash-corrected), relevered at D/E 0.156 (industry) and 21% tax to about 0.98, giving cost of equity of about 9.2%. After-tax cost of debt 4.2% (5.29% pretax). Weights 86.5% equity and 13.5% debt, giving about 8.5%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and in line with long-run nominal GDP/inflation.

net_debt.source: acc. 0001628280-26-004195: total debt 21,700 (LTD noncurrent 20,532 + current 1,168) less cash 4,121; no short-term investments reported.
